g.text: PartitionProcessor.process(row) walks each event through the sketch, then the heap
V7 not yet in local top-K
WHY THIS DECISION IS NEVER TRUSTED AT MERGE TIME
This heap update reflects ONLY what PartitionProcessor has seen in THIS partition, so far --
a visitor with a low early estimate here can still be a global top-K visitor once every partition is summed.
MergeCoordinator.finalize() re-queries globalSketch.estimate(visitorId) fresh for every candidate --
it never sums or trusts the counts stored in any partition's local heap snapshot.
